title: Explicit limiting cone for the strict-henselization fibre product
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be any morphism of schemes, $\bar y:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to Y$ a geometric point [def-weil-geometric-point], and $\mathcal J$ the small representative category of affine pointed etale neighbourhoods from [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit]. Let $A:\mathcal J\to Y_{\Et}$ forget the pointing, and put $B_j=A_j\times_YX$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. Let $q:Y^{\mathrm{sh}}\to Y$ be [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-structural-map]. There is a limit cone of the underlying schemes $B_j$, with vertex $Y^{\mathrm{sh}}\times_YX$, whose leg $\pi_j$ has second projection to $X$ equal to the second projection $p:Y^{\mathrm{sh}}\times_YX\to X$, and whose first projection to $A_j$ equals the first projection to $Y^{\mathrm{sh}}$ followed by its canonical leg $c_j$ (the spectrum cone leg followed by $\operatorname{Spec}\Gamma(A_j)\cong A_j$).

source.place: Theorem Tag 03Q9 (theorem-higher-direct-images), proof in degree zero; Theorem Tag 09YQ (theorem-colimit), and Tag 03S2

proof.text: Use the double-opposite equivalence to reindex the canonical spectrum limit from [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit]. The Gamma-Spec adjunction unit is a componentwise isomorphism on the affine stages. Postcomposing the cone by its inverse transports the limit to the diagram A. The inverse component is Spec.map (GammaSpecIso _).inv.

By [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-structural-map], every leg followed by the stage structure map is q. Define the new legs by the two projections of [def-pc-fibre-product]. Naturality is proved by checking the two projections and using original cone naturality. Pullback pasting identifies each leg square over the original cone as a pullback.

Cofilteredness from [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit] gives connectedness. Mathlib CategoryTheory.Limits.isLimitOfIsPullbackOfIsConnected (Limits/Shapes/Pullback/Connected.lean:30) applies to the original limit and the cartesian leg squares, proving the new cone is a limit. The two leg formulas are the defining pullback.lift projection equations.
